rule: score >= quantile(train_scores, 1 - top_frac); TRAIN only (paper-trade-v1 Entrada A)
why: Matches WF ultra-select (P@top≈100% for trainQ top1%/top5% and topK≤500). Live must NOT use top-K every ~10s batch — that over-enters vs ~top100/fold (~34/day). Default top_frac=0.01 ≈ 48.7 trades/day in OOS; pair with max_per_hour≈2.
